sloka: न क्षमम् च अपराद्धानाम् गमनम् स्वामि पार्श्वतः ।प्रधानबूताः च वयम् सुग्रीवस्य समागताः ॥४-५३-२३॥
transliteration: na kṣamam ca aparāddhānām gamanam svāmi pārśvataḥ ।pradhānabūtāḥ ca vayam sugrīvasya samāgatāḥ ॥4-53-23॥

translations.english: You all are trusted and expert in the ways of policy, devoted to your master's welfare, and sent forth on every task with instructions.
